invariants.rationale: inputRecords should not be null before processing; NullPointerException may occur otherwise.
instantTime is expected to represent a valid point in time and should be non-null and non-empty.
table is required for all core operations in the method; must not be null.
config is a necessary parameter for configuration-dependent logic; must not be null.
executor is cast and invoked inside the method, so must not be null.
